questions.heading: Every Request Is Checked Against One Transition Table
questions.stem: A scenario in Post-Opt has its 2030 budget edited by a planner. Under the transition table, which state is it in afterwards?

options.text: Post-Opt, with its last run still shown as the scenario's plan
options.says: ('Post-Opt', 'edit') maps to 'Pre-Opt': the last run no longer matches the inputs.

options.text: Initial, so that its data checks run again before the next solve
options.says: Edits stay in Initial only for an Initial scenario; a Post-Opt edit goes to Pre-Opt.

options.text: Pre-Opt, so that it is solved again before anyone reads a plan
options.says: Right: ('Post-Opt', 'edit') maps to 'Pre-Opt' in the table.

options.text: Post-Opt, with the run marked stale until a planner reruns it
options.says: The table moves an edited Post-Opt scenario to Pre-Opt; it does not stay in Post-Opt.

questions.heading: A Write Names the Version It Read, and a Stale Write Is Refused
questions.stem: Two planners read a scenario at version 7. The first saves a 2029 change, and the scenario is now at version 8. The second then saves a 2031 change, stamped with version 7. What does the service do?

options.text: Stores the second change on top, since it touched a different year
options.says: The service never merges: 'planner-b's first save is refused, not merged.'

options.text: Refuses the second save and asks for the scenario to be read again
options.says: Right: a write from a version that is no longer current is refused.

options.text: Stores the second planner's whole scenario over the first one's
options.says: That would undo the first planner's 2029 change: a lost update, which the version check refuses.

options.text: Merges the two changes into one new version of the stored scenario
options.says: The service refuses rather than merges; the design note is 'Refuse, Don't Merge'.

questions.heading: A Run Belongs to the Version It Started From
questions.stem: A run starts while the scenario is at version 4. During the solve a planner edits the scenario, which moves it to version 5. The run then finishes with an optimal plan. What does the service do with the run?

options.text: Attaches it, and the scenario moves to Post-Opt with that plan
options.says: The program printed 'run finished, attach: refused'.

options.text: Attaches it, but flags the plan as solved on the earlier inputs
options.says: The design note rejects attaching a stale run with a warning; the run is refused.

options.text: Undoes the planner's edit, so the inputs match the finished run
options.says: The edit stands at the new version; it is the run that is refused.

options.text: Refuses it, and the scenario stays in Pre-Opt until a rerun ends
options.says: Right: a run belongs to the version it started from, and the rerun is attached.
